title.zh: 萨卡拉的左塞阶梯金字塔

alt.en: A broad stone pyramid rises in six steps, with modern scaffolding around its lower courses.
alt.zh: 宽阔石金字塔以六级台阶升起，下部石层周围搭有现代脚手架。

caption.en: Djoser’s pyramid belongs to the Old Kingdom burial landscape around Memphis.
caption.zh: 左塞金字塔属于孟菲斯周边的古王国墓葬景观。

interpretation.en: Its stepped profile makes one stage in the development of royal stone tombs visible.
interpretation.zh: 阶梯轮廓呈现王室石墓发展中的一个阶段。

alt.en: A tapered earthen tower with projecting wooden beams rises behind thick walls.

caption.en: Djingareyber is one of Timbuktu’s historic mosques and centres of learning.
caption.zh: 金加雷贝尔是廷巴克图的历史清真寺和学习中心之一。

interpretation.en: Thick earth walls and projecting timbers make the building’s materials visible; its survival depends on repeated maintenance.
interpretation.zh: 厚土墙与外伸木梁让建筑材料清晰可见；建筑的延续依靠反复维护。

alt.en: A flat-topped sandstone hill rises above bush and grass.

caption.en: This is the hill occupied by Mapungubwe’s elite during the thirteenth century.
caption.zh: 这座山丘在13世纪为马蓬古布韦精英所居。

interpretation.en: Compare the raised summit with the lower ground: topography helped organize social separation.
interpretation.zh: 将高处山顶与低地比较：地形参与了社会空间的分隔。

alt.en: Rows of low stone walls mark tightly packed houses beside a central lane.
alt.zh: 成排低矮石墙标示中央巷道两侧紧密排列的住宅。

caption.en: The village housed workers on royal tombs and their families during Egypt’s New Kingdom.
caption.zh: 埃及新王国时期，王室墓葬工匠及其家人在此居住。

interpretation.en: The repeated rooms shift attention from royal tombs to the households that built them.
interpretation.zh: 重复排列的房间将视线从王陵转向建造王陵的家庭。

alt.en: Steps cross a roofless masonry court, with arched openings in its surrounding walls.
alt.zh: 阶梯穿过无顶砌体庭院，周围墙体上可见拱形开口。

caption.en: Songo Mnara preserves houses, mosques and open spaces from a medieval Swahili town.
caption.zh: 松戈姆纳拉保存一座中世纪斯瓦希里城镇的住宅、清真寺与开放空间。

interpretation.en: Connected rooms and passages place households beside trade in the history of the Swahili coast.
interpretation.zh: 相连的房间和通道将家庭生活与贸易并列为斯瓦希里海岸的历史内容。

caption.en: Lamu’s historic streets connect coral-stone houses, courtyards and places of learning.
caption.zh: 拉穆历史街巷连接珊瑚石住宅、庭院与学习场所。

alt.en: Six large stone moai stand on a low platform; one wears a red stone topknot.
alt.zh: 六尊大型摩艾石像立于低台上，其中一尊戴有红色石顶髻。

caption.en: Ancient moai at Ahu Tongariki were re-erected during a twentieth-century restoration.
caption.zh: 汤加里基的古代摩艾石像在20世纪修复工程中重新竖立。

interpretation.en: Read figures and platform together as a ceremonial arrangement, while recognizing the restored presentation.
interpretation.zh: 将石像与平台视作整体仪式布局，同时注意今天的陈列经过修复。

alt.en: Low curving lines of stone divide shallow river water into pens.
alt.zh: 低矮弧形石列把浅河水分隔成围栏状空间。

caption.en: The Brewarrina fish traps embody Ngemba custodianship and knowledge of changing river flows.
caption.zh: 布雷瓦里纳捕鱼系统体现恩根巴人的守护责任与河流知识。

interpretation.en: Follow the curved walls to see how flowing water and fish movement shaped the design.
interpretation.zh: 沿弧形石墙观察水流和鱼类活动如何影响设计。

alt.en: A broad plaza is bordered by stepped stone platforms with the valley beyond.
alt.zh: 宽阔广场两侧为阶梯石台，远处可见山谷。

caption.en: Monte Albán’s builders reshaped a hill above the Oaxaca valleys into a Zapotec urban centre.
caption.zh: 蒙特阿尔班的建造者将瓦哈卡谷地之上的山丘改造为萨波特克城市中心。

interpretation.en: The level plaza and elevated platforms reveal labour spent on reshaping ground as well as raising buildings.
interpretation.zh: 平整广场与高台展现整治地面和营建建筑所需的共同劳动。

alt.en: Thick stone walls, terraces and an entrance define a monumental complex.
alt.zh: 厚石墙、台地与入口构成纪念性建筑群。

caption.en: Chavín’s ceremonial centre combined open gathering places with controlled galleries and passages.
caption.zh: 查文仪式中心将开放集会空间与受控制的内部廊道结合。

interpretation.en: Compare open space and narrow access points to explore how architecture organized different experiences.
interpretation.zh: 比较开放空间与狭窄入口，理解建筑如何组织不同体验。

alt.en: A white marble mausoleum with a large dome and four minarets faces a long water channel.
alt.zh: 白色大理石陵墓拥有大穹顶与四座尖塔，面向长水渠。

caption.en: Shah Jahan commissioned the Taj Mahal as a mausoleum for Mumtaz Mahal in the seventeenth century.
caption.zh: 沙贾汗于17世纪为穆姆塔兹·玛哈尔营建泰姬陵。

interpretation.en: The water axis, paired elements and central dome organize remembrance through a carefully planned approach.
interpretation.zh: 水渠轴线、对称构件与中央穹顶通过精心规划的路径表达纪念。

title.en: The streets and buildings of Sirkap
title.zh: 锡尔卡普的街道与建筑遗址

alt.en: Low excavated stone walls outline adjoining rooms and building plots across a grassy settlement site.
alt.zh: 低矮发掘石墙在长草的聚落遗址中勾勒相邻房间与建筑地块。

caption.en: Sirkap was a planned settlement within Taxila’s wider sequence of cities.
caption.zh: 锡尔卡普是塔克西拉多座城市发展序列中的规划聚落。

interpretation.en: Repeated walls and adjoining plots make the city’s organization visible at the scale of buildings and rooms.
interpretation.zh: 重复墙体与相邻地块使城市组织在建筑和房间尺度上可见。

alt.en: A carved stupa with a Buddha image stands between ornate rock-cut pillars, viewed at an angle.
alt.zh: 雕有佛像的佛塔立于装饰繁密的岩凿柱列间，照片采用倾斜视角。

caption.en: Ajanta’s Cave 26 belongs to the later flowering of Buddhist rock-cut architecture and sculpture.
caption.zh: 阿旃陀第26窟属于佛教岩凿建筑与雕塑的较晚繁盛阶段。

interpretation.en: Pillars and the curving aisle shape movement around a sacred focus cut from the rock itself.
interpretation.zh: 柱列与弧形通道组织绕行，神圣焦点也由岩体本身凿成。

alt.en: A carved semicircular threshold and steps between guardian reliefs lead toward a seated Buddha and stone columns.
alt.zh: 雕刻半圆门阶与两侧守护者浮雕之间的台阶通向坐佛及石柱。

caption.en: The Vatadage is part of Polonnaruwa’s Buddhist ceremonial landscape.
caption.zh: 瓦塔达格是波隆纳鲁沃佛教仪式景观的一部分。

interpretation.en: Threshold, stair, guardians and Buddha turn an entrance into a sequence of carved encounters.
interpretation.zh: 门阶、阶梯、守护者与佛像，使入口成为连续的雕刻体验。

title.zh: 法泰赫普尔西克里的五层宫

alt.en: Five diminishing tiers of open pillared pavilions rise above a stone court.
alt.zh: 五层逐级缩小的开敞柱廊楼阁耸立在石铺庭院旁。

caption.en: The Panch Mahal forms part of Akbar’s late-sixteenth-century court complex.
caption.zh: 五层宫是阿克巴16世纪晚期宫廷建筑群的一部分。

interpretation.en: Open columns and diminishing terraces offer a contrast to the enclosed rooms of other court buildings.
interpretation.zh: 开敞柱列与逐级退台，可与其他宫廷建筑的封闭房间对照。

alt.en: A tall cylindrical brick stupa rises above low vegetation.

caption.en: Bawbawgyi belongs to Sri Ksetra, one of the three inscribed Pyu Ancient Cities.

interpretation.zh: 佛塔显示佛教供养的规模，周边城市还包括城墙、护城河与耕地。

alt.en: A steep staircase follows pale curved masonry beneath a deep blue sky.
alt.zh: 陡峭阶梯沿浅色弧形砌体上升，背景是深蓝天空。

caption.en: This is a detail of the Brihat Samrat Yantra at Jaipur’s eighteenth-century observatory.
caption.zh: 这是斋浦尔18世纪天文台的大型萨姆拉特日晷局部。

interpretation.en: Curved surfaces and monumental scale turn astronomical relationships into architecture; the whole instrument extends beyond this close view.
interpretation.zh: 弧面与巨大尺度把天文关系转化为建筑；完整仪器超出这一近景。

title.zh: 昌基略的太阳观测塔列

alt.en: Thirteen low towers follow a desert ridge in a regularly spaced line.
alt.zh: 十三座低塔等距排列在沙漠山脊上。

caption.en: From designated observing points, the towers marked the Sun’s changing position through the year.
caption.zh: 从特定观测点看，塔列标示太阳在一年中不断变化的位置。

interpretation.en: The whole horizon matters: a sequence of towers can mark a calendar, rather than a single solstice.
interpretation.zh: 整个地平线都很重要：连续塔列能标记年历，而非只指示一次至日。

alt.en: Excavated earthen walls and compartments of a small building are exposed in an overhead view.
alt.zh: 从上方可见，一座小建筑的土墙与分隔空间在发掘区中露出。

caption.zh: 约公元600年，火山灰掩埋这座玛雅农业村落，保存日常劳动的证据。

interpretation.en: Small rooms and earthen construction put domestic life at the centre of the archaeological story.
interpretation.zh: 小房间与土质建筑使家庭生活成为考古叙事的中心。

title.en: Stonework in Harar’s old city wall
title.zh: 哈勒尔旧城墙的石砌结构

alt.en: Regular dressed blocks meet rougher rubble masonry in a close view of Harar’s old wall.
alt.zh: 哈勒尔旧墙近景中，规整加工石块与粗糙碎石砌体相接。

caption.en: Harar’s historic wall forms part of a living Muslim urban landscape in Ethiopia.
caption.zh: 哈勒尔历史城墙是埃塞俄比亚一座延续至今的穆斯林城市景观的组成部分。

interpretation.en: The close view reveals the wall as accumulated masonry and maintenance, not simply a line around a city.
interpretation.zh: 近景显示城墙是砌筑和维护的累积，不只是围绕城市的一条线。

context.en: Its stepped profile makes one stage in the development of royal stone tombs visible.
context.zh: 阶梯轮廓呈现王室石墓发展中的一个阶段。

context.en: Thick earth walls and projecting timbers make the building’s materials visible; its survival depends on repeated maintenance.
context.zh: 厚土墙与外伸木梁让建筑材料清晰可见；建筑的延续依靠反复维护。

context.en: Compare the raised summit with the lower ground: topography helped organize social separation.
context.zh: 将高处山顶与低地比较：地形参与了社会空间的分隔。

context.en: The repeated rooms shift attention from royal tombs to the households that built them.
context.zh: 重复排列的房间将视线从王陵转向建造王陵的家庭。

context.en: Connected rooms and passages place households beside trade in the history of the Swahili coast.
context.zh: 相连的房间和通道将家庭生活与贸易并列为斯瓦希里海岸的历史内容。

context.en: The wall supports and decorates an elevated living platform: masonry organized status as well as space.
context.zh: 墙体支撑并装饰抬高的居住平台，砌石既组织空间，也表达身份。

context.en: Street width and closely joined houses reveal the neighbourhood scale of a Swahili port.
context.zh: 街巷尺度与毗连住宅呈现斯瓦希里港城的邻里生活。

context.en: Read figures and platform together as a ceremonial arrangement, while recognizing the restored presentation.
context.zh: 将石像与平台视作整体仪式布局，同时注意今天的陈列经过修复。

context.en: Follow the curved walls to see how flowing water and fish movement shaped the design.
context.zh: 沿弧形石墙观察水流和鱼类活动如何影响设计。

context.en: The level plaza and elevated platforms reveal labour spent on reshaping ground as well as raising buildings.
context.zh: 平整广场与高台展现整治地面和营建建筑所需的共同劳动。

context.en: The stair leads the eye upward while the burial lies below, linking public monument and hidden tomb.
context.zh: 阶梯引导视线上升，墓葬却位于下方，将公共纪念建筑与隐蔽陵墓联系起来。

context.en: Compare open space and narrow access points to explore how architecture organized different experiences.
context.zh: 比较开放空间与狭窄入口，理解建筑如何组织不同体验。

context.en: Circular building outlines bring residential life into a site often introduced only through its great outer wall.
context.zh: 圆形建筑轮廓使居住生活进入视野，而这处遗址常只以巨大外墙为人所知。

context.en: Repeated tiers and the steep approach make ordered ascent part of the monument’s effect.
context.zh: 重复层台与陡峭阶梯使有序上升成为建筑体验的一部分。

context.en: The water axis, paired elements and central dome organize remembrance through a carefully planned approach.
context.zh: 水渠轴线、对称构件与中央穹顶通过精心规划的路径表达纪念。

context.en: Repeated walls and adjoining plots make the city’s organization visible at the scale of buildings and rooms.
context.zh: 重复墙体与相邻地块使城市组织在建筑和房间尺度上可见。

context.en: Pillars and the curving aisle shape movement around a sacred focus cut from the rock itself.
context.zh: 柱列与弧形通道组织绕行，神圣焦点也由岩体本身凿成。

context.en: Threshold, stair, guardians and Buddha turn an entrance into a sequence of carved encounters.
context.zh: 门阶、阶梯、守护者与佛像，使入口成为连续的雕刻体验。

context.en: Open columns and diminishing terraces offer a contrast to the enclosed rooms of other court buildings.
context.zh: 开敞柱列与逐级退台，可与其他宫廷建筑的封闭房间对照。

context.en: The stupa marks Buddhist patronage within a wider city of walls, moats and cultivated land.
context.zh: 佛塔显示佛教供养的规模，周边城市还包括城墙、护城河与耕地。

context.en: The carved figures accompany the descent toward water, joining practical access with a sacred architectural setting.
context.zh: 雕刻人物伴随通向水面的下降路径，将实用取水与神圣建筑环境结合。

context.en: Bridge, water and houses show how movement and inhabited streets worked together in the port.
context.zh: 桥、水道与住宅共同呈现港城交通与日常街巷的联系。

context.en: Compare the vessels’ size and spacing; dates established at one sampled site do not automatically date every visible jar.
context.zh: 比较石缸尺寸与间距；某一采样遗址的测年不能自动适用于所有可见石缸。

context.en: The pillar is evidence of Mauryan-era commemoration; it does not supply a contemporary birth record of the Buddha.
context.zh: 石柱见证孔雀王朝时期的纪念活动，并非佛陀诞生当时的记录。

context.en: Curved surfaces and monumental scale turn astronomical relationships into architecture; the whole instrument extends beyond this close view.
context.zh: 弧面与巨大尺度把天文关系转化为建筑；完整仪器超出这一近景。

context.en: Follow water and retaining walls across the slope: this landscape depends on continuing community work.
context.zh: 沿坡面观察水流与挡墙：这片景观依靠社群持续维护。

context.en: Compare upright markers and horizontal courses while recognizing that excavated monuments have also been restored.
context.zh: 比较直立石与水平石层，同时注意发掘后的古迹也经过修复。

context.en: The whole horizon matters: a sequence of towers can mark a calendar, rather than a single solstice.
context.zh: 整个地平线都很重要：连续塔列能标记年历，而非只指示一次至日。

context.en: The junction between masonry traditions makes the city’s layered history visible.
context.zh: 不同砌筑传统的交界让城市的多层历史可见。

context.en: Small rooms and earthen construction put domestic life at the centre of the archaeological story.
context.zh: 小房间与土质建筑使家庭生活成为考古叙事的中心。

context.en: The close view reveals the wall as accumulated masonry and maintenance, not simply a line around a city.
context.zh: 近景显示城墙是砌筑和维护的累积，不只是围绕城市的一条线。
